row.team_price_text: Growth: estimate after installing the snippet (session-based)
row.evidence: Heap's pricing comparison table marks SCIM ("SCIM provisioning allows you to add and remove teammates in Heap directly from your identity management app") as included on Premier only, and Pro and Premier are "Custom Session Pricing, Contact Us".
row.notes: Session-based pricing: Free (up to 10k monthly sessions), Growth (price shown only after installing the snippet), Pro and Premier (Custom Session Pricing, Contact Us), so all per-user fields are null. SAML SSO is on every plan including Free; SCIM and audit logs are Premier-only. SCIM needs an existing SSO setup and a bearer token from Account > Manage > Account settings. Heap documents SCIM for Okta (OIN app with SCIM) and OneLogin, and points to JumpCloud's own Heap SCIM connector; Azure/Entra and Google Workspace are SSO-only. Deactivating or unassigning a user in the IdP deletes the Heap account (reactivation recreates it). Email/userName changes are not supported (a new account is created). Roles map through a 'Heap Role' parameter, with a default role for new users. Heap does not publish a SCIM base URL or attribute list; JumpCloud's page shows https://heapanalytics.com/scim/v2/[tenant]. No admin user-management API was found (Heap's APIs are for tracking data). Product is now part of Contentsquare.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivating or unassigning the user in the IdP deletes the Heap account; reactivation recreates it.

roles.how: 'Heap Role' parameter in Okta (Provisioning > To App) or OneLogin (Parameters tab), else the default role picked when enabling SCIM. Okta Group Push creates or links Heap teams.

limitations.text: Once SCIM is enabled, teammates can only be added or removed from the IdP, not in Heap.
Changing a user's email or userName is not supported; it creates a new, separate account.
Users with a Heap account in another organization must delete it and be re-created.
JumpCloud SCIM is a JumpCloud-documented connector; Heap refers questions to JumpCloud.

user_api.notes: developers.heap.io documents tracking and user-property APIs only; no teammate-management API found.

okta.notes: OIN Heap app lists SAML, SWA and SCIM.

entra.notes: Heap's guide creates a non-gallery SAML app; no Entra provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: From Heap's OneLogin guide (OneLogin catalogue not loaded).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud's page gives the SCIM base URL https://heapanalytics.com/scim/v2/[tenant] and requires the Heap Premier plan.
